display.title: Episode 454: The Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Kislev, the month of miracles: sign up for Tzivos Hashem, beat the yetzer hara with joy, a 'waltzy' march, Shema, and chapter 1 of the Ten Wedding Gifts.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens in the month of Kislev of 5751, the year of wonders, and calls on children to enlist every Jewish boy and girl, even newborn babies, in Tzivos Hashem, whose weapons are Torah and mitzvos. A soldier's real enemy is the yetzer hara inside: like a seesaw, the more Torah and mitzvos, the higher the yetzer tov and the lower the yetzer hara, and the yetzer hara loves a sad child, so serve Hashem with joy. This week's Hakochainik march is a lively waltz. A second-grade class from Beis Yaakov of Boro Park recites the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time begins 'The Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts': Reuven, a kind innkeeper, raises two orphans, Avraham and Sarah, arranges their marriage and gives them 600 gold pieces for wedding clothes. On the road they meet an old man in chains crying for help, and give the whole purse to a cruel officer to set him free. Penniless, they head home. To be continued. The show ends with a call to recruit new soldiers and candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Use Torah and mitzvos, and a happy heart, to win the battle against the yetzer hara; true kindness is giving up what is yours to save another.
